dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: That place over there is a secret base—nobody else is allowed in.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: If you peek through the hole where the water sound comes from, there are tons of koi.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: Don't tell the grown-ups, okay? Promise.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: Did you see the potato sorting?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yeah. They were separating the big ones from the small ones.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Every single one is a different shape and size.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: It looks easy, but you really have to look carefully.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: I've helped before. It makes your eyes tired.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: I see. That sounds like hard work.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: But it feels really good when you finish sorting them.

updateNotebook.memo: Every potato is a different shape and size. You have to look carefully.
updateNotebook.quote: You really have to look carefully.
updateNotebook.speaker: child2

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: Did you come to play again?

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: My big brother didn't come back again this year.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: We used to play together in that house.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: But the water just keeps flowing, same as always.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Grandpa said so—as long as there's water, he'll come back someday.

updateNotebook.memo: Some people never come back. But the water keeps flowing as always.
updateNotebook.quote: Grandpa said—as long as there's water, he'll come back someday.
updateNotebook.speaker: child1
